items.source: Mapped statements can be used directly with DatabaseClient.sql(Supplier) without specifying further SQL or bindings as the prepared operation encapsulates the specified SQL operation.

items.source: Mapper for statement specifications to PreparedOperation. Statement mapping applies a R2dbcDialect-specific transformation considering BindMarkers and vendor-specific SQL differences.
items.translation: 将语句规范映射到PreparedOperation的映射器。语句映射应用了特定于R2dbcDialect的转换，该转换考虑了BindMarkers以及供应商特定的 SQL 差异。
